resource.title: High Performance Scientific Computing（Randall J. LeVeque, University of Washington，免费在线讲义）
resource.covers: UW AMath 483/583 的公开讲义（Sphinx 站点，含目录、代码与作业）。技术主题为 Python/numpy 科学计算、Fortran 90/95、编译与优化、性能与 profiling、OpenMP 与 MPI 并行（含 Jacobi 迭代的 OpenMP/MPI 版本与计时）、版本控制与可复现的软件环境，应用章节给数值工作负载与并行求解的具体实现；通信优化、可扩展性与能耗只在并行章节中部分涉及。

courses.prereq_text: Recommended Background — Experience writing and debugging computer programs is required --- preferably experience with scientific, mathematical, or statistical computing applications. Many of the examples used in lectures and assignments will require this background. Past exposure to numerical analysis is a plus.

CS267 is intended to be useful for students from many departments and with different backgrounds, although we will assume reasonable programming skills in a conventional (non-parallel) language, as well as enough mathematical skills to understand the problems and algorithmic solutions presented.

extra_prereqs.evidence: UW AMath 483/583 写 'Experience writing and debugging computer programs is required'；Berkeley CS267 假设 'reasonable programming skills in a conventional (non-parallel) language'
UW AMath 483/583：'preferably experience with scientific, mathematical, or statistical computing applications'
UW AMath 483/583：'Past exposure to numerical analysis is a plus'

notes: M.8.1 记 recommended：UW AMath 483/583 只说“学过一点数值分析是加分”。C.5.1 记 not_mentioned：CS267 的原文反而明确假设学生只会“conventional (non-parallel) language”编程（即不要求先修并行编程），UW 那门课也没提并行先修；按“contradicted 需要课程明说不需要”的定义，这里只是没提，故不写 contradicted。资源用 LeVeque 的讲义而不是 CS267 主页，是因为讲义本身可系统阅读（Python/Fortran/OpenMP/MPI/应用/作业），CS267 主页只给日程与 slides 链接；CS267 用的是 2016 年版公开页面，仍然可访问。
